# t4.1 — Feature Boundary Conformance

## Summary

Migrated remaining feature entry points to the shared `FeatureContext`. Added typed UI, calculation, widget, market-data, and event seams while preserving legacy public entry points and existing behavior.

## Changes

- Extended `FeatureContext` with `ports` and a typed `events` bus.
- Added `src/core/feature-ports.ts` as the compatibility composition adapter for shared calculations, UI primitives, dashboard widgets, and market-data refreshes.
- Routed calculators, tax planner, dashboard, ESOP, plan, and profile state access through injected context.
- Routed feature persistence through `context.portfolio.save(...)`, preserving `awaitCloud` and `sync` options.
- Moved profile NAV refresh and dashboard NAV refresh behind `marketData.refreshPortfolioNAVs(...)`.
- Replaced plan helper imports from dashboard/calculator/watchdog implementations with core calculation ports.
- Updated the registry composition root to pass one context instance to every feature entry point.
- Preserved the tax planner's standalone EPF preference in `localStorage`; this remains the separate decision explicitly deferred by t2/t4.

## Upstream Artifacts Consumed

- `.github/modernize/rearchitecture/artifacts/t2-frontend.md` — existing registry/context/repository adapter and insurance migration pattern.
- `.github/modernize/rearchitecture/artifacts/t4-teamlead.md` — residual coupling inventory and required remediation.
- `.github/modernize/rearchitecture/artifacts/t1-architect.md` — core calculation, market-data, widget, UI, and event seam contracts.
- `.github/modernize/rearchitecture/learnings/frontend/feature-context-ports.md` — compatibility-first context migration guidance.

## Evidence Mapping

- `t1-architect.md#Feature Extension Contract` -> `src/core/feature-context.ts` now carries state, repository, typed ports, and typed events; all registry-mounted features receive the same context.
- `t1-architect.md#Concrete Seams for Existing Couplings` -> `src/core/feature-ports.ts` centralizes calculations, market-data refresh, UI, and widget adapters; feature modules no longer import sibling implementation paths.
- `t4-teamlead.md#Failed requirements` -> residual `appState`, `persistPortfolioState`, and sibling implementation imports were removed from `src/modules`; only the explicitly deferred tax EPF preference uses `localStorage`.
- `t2-frontend.md#Behavior Boundary` -> repository remains the compatibility wrapper over existing storage semantics; public module entry points remain available with optional context parameters.

## Residual Scope

The tax planner still reads/writes `epf_annual_contribution` directly in browser storage. This is a standalone calculator preference, not portfolio persistence, and remains outside this task per the t2/t4 decision. The core compatibility adapter still imports existing implementation files internally; feature code consumes the typed port surface.
